_about: Stat gains per Pioneer level applied to the survivor's vitals (M8d). ASSUMPTION: +5 max health, +3 max energy per level; the six named stats are display-only until the skills milestone (M10) gives them effects.
_xp_curve: Owner 2026-10-28: each level costs exponentially more. Level n (stored, 0 = Lv. 1) costs round(base x growth^n) XP. ASSUMPTION base 110, growth 1.12: Lv 1-10 stay near the old 100 + 25 n, higher levels grow. The bottom bar draws one segment per segment_xp XP, grouped into a multiple of it past max_segments.
